[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The Australian birth index lists John Glasgow, born 1840 in New South Wales, son of Alexander Glasgow and Helen Glasgow.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568701 Ancestry birth index, John Glasgow, 1840, New South Wales]</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568702 Companion index entry]</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Identity hold. The two volume references may index one child. Do not identify him with John Bowling Glasgow: the 1849 entry names Mary A as mother.

== Biography ==
The Australian birth index lists Patrick Glasgow, born about 1847 in Melbourne, Victoria, son of Thomas Glasgow and Mary Foley.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/1113262 Ancestry birth index, Patrick Glasgow, about 1847, Melbourne]</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/1113263 Companion index entry]</ref>

== Research Notes ==
Identity hold. Four index references appear to represent the same child and parents; they are not independent identities.
